<!doctype html>
<html class="no-js" lang="{{ request.locale.iso_code }}">
  <head>

  {{ 'cart-drawer.css' | asset_url | stylesheet_tag }}

    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
    <meta name="theme-color" content="#ab273b">
    <link rel="canonical" href="{{ canonical_url }}">

    <!-- Swiper CSS & JS for interactive touch sliders -->
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.css" />
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.js"></script>
    
    <title>
      {{ page_title }}
      {%- if current_tags %} – tagged "{{ current_tags | join: ', ' }}"{% endif -%}
      {%- if current_page != 1 %} – Page {{ current_page }}{% endif -%}
      {%- unless page_title contains shop.name %} – {{ shop.name }}{% endunless -%}
    </title>

    {% if page_description %}
      <meta name="description" content="{{ page_description | escape }}">
    {% endif %}

    <!-- Google Fonts: Poppins -->
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400;1,700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <!-- Global Base Styles & Theme CSS -->
    {{ 'base.css' | asset_url | stylesheet_tag }}
    {{ 'custom-equipro.css' | asset_url | stylesheet_tag }}
    {{ 'quote-modal.css' | asset_url | stylesheet_tag }}

    {{ content_for_header }}
  </head>

  <body>
    <!-- Header & Category Subnav Section Groups -->
    {% sections 'header-group' %}
    {% section 'category-subnav' %}

    <!-- Main Content Container -->
    <main id="MainContent" class="content-for-layout focus-none" role="main" tabindex="-1">
      {{ content_for_layout }}
    </main>

    <!-- Footer Section Group -->
    {% sections 'footer-group' %}

    <!-- Global B2B Quote Modal Integration -->
    {% render 'quote-modal' %}

    <!-- Global Scripts -->
    <script src="{{ 'quote-modal.js' | asset_url }}" defer="defer"></script>
    {% render 'cart-drawer' %}
  </body>
</html>
